Together, @cancersociety.bsky.social , its funding partners, these experts and their teams are turning groundbreaking research projects into a future where #cancer prevention is more proactive, more personalized and more accessible – allowing us to stop cancer before it starts.

Finally, CCS and @terryfoxresearch.bsky.social are funding Dr Alberto Martin, who is researching a common gut microbe to understand its link to #cancer. He and his team will study how dietary fibre and supplements affect the microbe and its connection to #ColonCancer and other growths in the colon.

In partnership with @terryfoxresearch.bsky.social , CCS is supporting Dr Vincent Fradet’s research into how #ProstateCancer and gut bacteria affect one another. This work may lead to new ways of predicting #cancer and may even lead to new treatments that can reduce the aggressiveness of the disease.

In partnership with the CIHR Institute of Nutrition, Metabolism and Diabetes, CCS is supporting Dr Rachel Murphy’s research into whether ultra-processed foods cause #ColonCancer. The team will also study how these foods affect gut bacteria and how changes to the gut bacteria may affect #cancer.

Also in partnership with the CIHR ICR, CCS is funding Dr Luke McCaffrey and his team in understanding why some lesions become #BreastCancer and others don’t – allowing people who need #cancer treatment to receive it quickly and those who don’t to avoid unnecessary procedures and side effects.

In partnership with the CIHR Institute of #Cancer Research (ICR), CCS is supporting Dr Mark Basik’s work on better #BreastCancer screening for young women. Using AI-assisted imaging and genomics, they aim to understand which people would benefit from specialized screening or preventive treatment.

Up to 40% of #cancers are preventable – and new #research can help us stop cancer before it starts. That’s why, together, @cancersociety.bsky.social and partners are funding 7 teams committed to preventing cancer, reducing risk and improving early detection and diagnosis in Canada and worldwide.

An international collaboration to prevent #cancer!

Today @cancersociety.bsky.social , CIHR, @terryfoxresearch.bsky.social , the Japan Agency for Medical Research & Development, the Cancer Research Society & @biocanrx.bsky.social are investing $41.5 million to change the future of cancer prevention.
